description: Discussion / Closes / Fixes / Backpatch-through trailers attached to one commit. Returns the raw trailer text and any URL extracted. For the messages those links resolve to, plus the committers announcement and messages citing the SHA, use git_search (mail_refs on each result).

commit_sha.description: The commit: a SHA (>= 7 hex), branch, tag, major version (17, 9.6), <ref>~N, or a commit_id from another tool, or a commit URL (gitweb, git.postgresql.org, GitHub, pg.ddx.io).

name: discussion_links
